description: Velocity / BungeeCord / Waterfall proxy metrics from bungeecord-prometheus-exporter 4.x.

panels.title: Players online, by backend server
panels.description: Derived from the proxy's player list, so the stack always sums to the network total.

panels.title: Player latency percentiles
panels.description: A histogram, so these percentiles aggregate correctly across every proxy in the selection. Summary quantiles could not be combined this way.

panels.title: Backend reachability
panels.description: Sampled by actually server-list-pinging each backend, so a red band appears before players start failing to connect.

panels.title: Kicks per minute, by origin server
Server-list pings per minute
panels.description: Clients viewing the server in their multiplayer list. A useful proxy for interest that never converts into a join.

panels.title: Plugins
panels.description: Useful for spotting a proxy left behind by a partial rollout.

panels.title: JVM heap
panels.description: Standard jvm_* metrics, not namespaced, so any JVM dashboard works against this target unmodified.

panels.title: Collector failures
panels.description: Non-zero means that collector threw and its metrics are missing from every scrape. The stack trace is in the proxy log, logged once per collector.

panels.title: Series dropped by the cardinality budget
panels.description: Raise collection.max-series-per-metric, or turn off the high-cardinality metric groups.
